dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - June 01, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
"Power Surge: Tigers Outlast Rays in Thrilling 10-9 Victory"

Dillon Dingler's explosive performance at the plate helped the Detroit Tigers secure a dramatic 10-9 win over the Tampa Bay Rays. Dingler's four hits, including two home runs, and four RBIs led the Tigers' offense, while the pitching staff combined for a strong effort. Meanwhile, in other action, the Miami Marlins took down the Washington Nationals 7-3 behind a solid outing from Cade Cavalli, who struck out six over five innings.
